disposition_reason: Table 2 prints the concentration range of each element across 68 commercial whiskies and Table 3 prints type means for 23 elements including cadmium.

study.design: Elemental fingerprinting of commercial whiskies by type and Scotch production area
study.origin: Bourbon, Tennessee (USA), Scotch (Scotland, by production area), Irish and Japanese whiskies from 40 distilleries, per label
study.market: Commercial products; purchase location not stated
study.method: ICP-MS (Agilent 8800, He mode) after 10-fold dilution in 1% HNO3/0.5% HCl; MP-AES for Ca, K, Mg, Na, Si
lod: Per element in Table 2 (µg/L), e.g. Cd 0.003, Pb 0.004, As 0.002, Cr 10.1, Ni 0.027
study.qa: No CRM for spirits; spike recovery into three whiskies 65% (Ba) to 121% (Pt) for ICP-MS, 102-117% for MP-AES; QC standards every 20 runs within 80-115%
